description.en: System notifications, sounds and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background. Approvals can be answered straight from the notification, and reminders can also be pushed to external channels (custom webhook, Discord, Bark, Gotify); notifications also support an in-page overlay for secondary monitors, per-kind sound choice, quiet periods, and zh/en notification language. Works in both DSH Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹出系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题。审批可直接在通知上裁决，提醒还能推送到外部通知通道（自定义 Webhook、Discord、Bark、Gotify）；另支持副屏浮层、按提醒类型选音效、静默时段与中英文通知语言。Web 版与桌面版均可用。
